fields.Intake — Published:
220 approved Management PG two-year seats in 2024–25 and 210 in 2023–24, official NIRF 2026. Current 2026–27 intake unconfirmed.
Published numeric intake: 220
fields.Fees — Published:
₹12.45 lakh tuition/registration + ₹34,000 compulsory academic charges = ₹12.79 lakh; hostel and day-scholar sports extra.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 12.79
fields.Fee Scope: Tuition ₹12 lakh, registration ₹45,000, two annual exam charges ₹12,000 each, co-curricular ₹3,000 each year, degree digitisation ₹2,500 and alumni ₹1,500. Refundable security ₹30,000 excluded. Day-scholar sports ₹52,000 extra over two years.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT, XAT, NMAT, MAT, CMAT, GMAT, BU-MAT or CUET; combined with graduation marks and interview.
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s in any discipline from recognised university with at least 50%; English as medium of instruction. Final-year applicants provisional until final marksheet. Work experience not mandatory.
fields.Selection Process: Weighted evaluation of entrance percentile, graduation and personal interview; academic background, interview and leadership potential considered. Numerical weights not published.
fields.Avg CTC — Published:
₹7.57 LPA on the official MBA page; cohort year not stated.
Reported mean ₹L: 7.57
fields.Median CTC — Published:
₹6 lakh median for 129 placed Management PG two-year graduates in 2024–25, official NIRF 2026.
Reported median ₹L: 6
fields.Highest CTC — Published: Official MBA page: ₹42 LPA headline marked with an asterisk; cohort and basis not established. It is not treated as a confirmed 2024–25 maximum.
fields.Placement — Published:
129 of 192 minimum-time graduates placed in 2024–25: 67.19%. One student pursued higher studies.
Published/calculated rate %: 67.19
fields.Placement Scope: NIRF 2026 Management: 2024–25 median ₹6 lakh and 129/192 graduates placed. The official MBA page separately reports undated salary headlines: mean ₹7.57 lakh and highest ₹42 lakh.
